title: Nutcracker Clipart, 12 Nutcracker Ballet PNG and SVG, Sugar Plum Dancer, Mouse King, Toy Drum and Snowflake, Christmas Sublimation Designs
description:
Twelve Nutcracker ballet clipart designs for Christmas: classic wooden nutcrackers, sugar plum style ballerinas, a crowned mouse king, a toy soldier drummer, a toy drum, a gold snowflake, pointe shoes, sugared plums and a ballerina music box. Each one comes as a full-color PNG with a transparent background at 300 dpi, plus a one-color SVG line-art version of the same design.

Use them for Christmas tees and sweatshirts, sublimation mugs and tumblers, tote bags, cards, gift tags, stickers, recital and party invitations and holiday crafts. The designs are drawn in a warm flat style with clean dark outlines, so they stay crisp on light and dark backgrounds.

THE 12 DESIGNS
1 Classic nutcracker · 2 Nutcracker portrait · 3 Navy nutcracker · 4 Sugar plum dancer · 5 Red tutu dancer · 6 Mouse king · 7 Gold snowflake · 8 Toy drum · 9 Drummer soldier · 10 Pointe shoes · 11 Sugar plums · 12 Music box

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 12 PNG files, transparent background, 300 dpi, 3600 px on the longest side (12 in), ready for sublimation, print and print-then-cut
• 12 SVG files: the same designs as single-layer, one-color line art that scales to any size
• One ZIP download with a README and the license

GOOD TO KNOW
• The SVGs are line-art versions for one-color printing, recoloring and crafts, not vinyl cut files: some lines are fine
• There is no text on the designs
• All designs are original: no ballet company, film or brand artwork
• The tee, card and tote in the photos show the designs in use; you receive the digital files only
• Colors vary a little between screens, printers and blanks

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on physical items you make and sell (tees, mugs, tumblers, totes, cards, stickers), up to 500 items per design. Please don't resell, share or upload the digital files, use them on print-on-demand marketplaces, or include them in other digital products.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
